fact: Agence Ecofin reports that the Central African Republic plans to finalise implementation of its universal service fund in 2026, a priority ARCEP unveiled on 15 April 2026, to extend access to telecom services including broadband internet, with operators deploying infrastructure in uncovered areas.

Agence Ecofin reports that the Central African authorities launched the activities of the CDCE, the body that oversees the universal service fund meant to extend basic telecom access across the territory, funded by a 2% operator revenue contribution.
